document.title: DCI Update, Islamic Extremist Terrorism Threat
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: DCI update on the Islamic extremist terrorism threat. Notes that UBL elements in Pakistan reportedly plan to attack the U.S. President's plane with missiles if he visits Pakistan. Cited in 9/11 Commission Report Chapter 6, Endnotes 63, 101.
